## History

Harmon Andrews is a member of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community who, alongside other residents, assessed the widespread damage left by an extraordinarily severe hail and thunderstorm. The severe storm destroyed local crops, damaged homes, killed Mr. Harrison's parrot, and ruined the trees that had been planted by the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P2](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P3](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. ## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harmon-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

Harmon Andrews is [Jane](../character/jane.md) Andrews's father, who once saved her from drowning by catching her by her sash when she nearly fell overboard into the lake. Their bond is rooted in this shared past event, placing Harmon in a protective role over [Jane](../character/jane.md).

- Saved — caught her by her sash as she nearly fell overboard into the lake  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068)</sub>
